containerVersion.name: Add GA4 event tags, triggers, and variables for engagement and subscription tracking
containerVersion.description:
Tags:
* Added "GA4 Event | sign_up" tag triggered by "CE - sign_up".
* Added "GA4 Event | subscribe_click header" tag triggered by "CLK - subscribe header".
* Added "GA4 Event | subscribe_click popup" tag triggered by "CLK - subscribe popup".
* Added "GA4 Event | subscribe_click inline" tag triggered by "CLK - subscribe inline".
* Added "GA4 Event | subscribe_click home" tag triggered by "CLK - subscribe home".
* Added "GA4 Event | subscribe_click footer" tag triggered by "CLK - subscribe footer".
* Added "GA4 Event | subscribe_popup_view" tag triggered by "EV - subscribe popup view".
* Added "GA4 Event | subscribe_popup_dismiss" tag triggered by "CLK - popup dismiss".
* Added "GA4 Event | read_time 30s" tag triggered by "TM - read 30s".
* Added "GA4 Event | read_time 60s" tag triggered by "TM - read 60s".
* Added "GA4 Event | read_time 120s" tag triggered by "TM - read 120s".
* Added "GA4 Event | scroll_depth" tag triggered by "SD - post scroll depth".

Triggers:
* Added custom event trigger "CE - sign_up".
* Added click triggers "CLK - subscribe header", "CLK - subscribe popup", "CLK - subscribe inline", "CLK - subscribe home", "CLK - subscribe footer", and "CLK - popup dismiss".
* Added timer triggers "TM - read 30s", "TM - read 60s", and "TM - read 120s".
* Added scroll depth trigger "SD - post scroll depth".
* Added element visibility trigger "EV - subscribe popup view".

Variables:
* Added constant variable "GA4 Measurement ID" set to "G-LW4GGGM6PK".
* Enabled built-in variables "Click Element", "Click Text", and "Scroll Depth Threshold".
